consequence.statement: HelmChart objects submitted on source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1beta2 that omit status.artifact.digest are rejected by the tightened schema validation.
consequence.remediation: Ensure HelmChart objects submitted on source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1beta2 include status.artifact.digest (the value the source controller records in status.artifact).

assertion.statement: The computed artifact diff between the v2.6.4 and v2.7.0 install bundles shows that status.artifact.digest is newly required in the source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1beta2 schema of helmcharts.source.toolkit.fluxcd.io, and HelmChart objects that omit it are rejected.
